import numpy as np
from tslearn.backend import Backend, instantiate_backend

# Instantiate the NumPy backend
be = instantiate_backend(backend="numpy")

# Create a small integer array
s1_int = np.array([1, 2, 3], dtype=np.int32)

# Call cast to convert it to float64
res = be.cast(s1_int, dtype=np.float64)

# Verify the result is correctly casted and retains its values
assert res.dtype == np.float64, f"Expected float64, got {res.dtype}"
assert res.shape == (3,), f"Expected shape (3,), got {res.shape}"
assert res[0] == 1.0, f"Expected 1.0, got {res[0]}"

print(f"__CHECK__ cast {res.dtype}")
